ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle B = 40^\circ$, $\angle C = 80^\circ$. $AE$ bisects $\angle BAC$ and intersects $BC$ at $E$, $AD \perp BC$ at $D$. Find the degree measure of $\angle EAD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:}\\
Since $AD \perp BC$,\\
it follows that $\angle ADC = 90^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle DAC = 180^\circ - \angle ADC - \angle C$,\\
it follows that $\angle DAC = 10^\circ$,\\
Since $AE$ bisects $\angle BAC$,\\
it follows that $\angle BAE = \angle CAE = 30^\circ$,\\
Therefore, $\angle EAD = \angle CAE - \angle DAC = \boxed{20^\circ}$.
